rider_name: Saffron Life Accidental Death Benefit Rider
benefit: Pays the rider sum assured in addition to the base death benefit if death is caused by an accident within 180 days of the accident.
rider_sa_rule: Rider SA <= base SA (ULIPs: <= the ULIP sum assured) and <= Rs 1 crore.
rider_term_rule: Not available with single pay. Rider premium is paid every year, together with the base premium, for the base premium-paying term, and rider cover lasts for that same period (so with limited pay the rider ends when base premiums end); cover and premiums stop earlier if the life assured reaches max_cover_age.
key_exclusions: Self-inflicted injury, intoxication, hazardous sports, war, criminal acts (simplified).

rider_name: Saffron Life Accidental Total & Permanent Disability Rider
benefit: Pays the rider sum assured if an accident causes total and permanent disability (simplified definition).
rider_sa_rule: Rider SA <= base SA and <= Rs 1 crore.
rider_term_rule: Not available with single pay. Rider premium is paid every year, together with the base premium, for the base premium-paying term, and rider cover lasts for that same period (so with limited pay the rider ends when base premiums end); cover and premiums stop earlier if the life assured reaches max_cover_age.
key_exclusions: As for the accidental death rider.

benefit: Pays the rider sum assured on first diagnosis of one of 20 listed critical illnesses (e.g. cancer of specified severity, first heart attack, stroke, kidney failure). Simplified list; survival period of 30 days after diagnosis.
rider_sa_rule: Rider SA <= base SA and <= Rs 50 lakh.
rider_term_rule: Not available with single pay. Rider premium is paid every year, together with the base premium, for the base premium-paying term, and rider cover lasts for that same period (so with limited pay the rider ends when base premiums end); cover and premiums stop earlier if the life assured reaches max_cover_age. 90-day waiting period from the start.
key_exclusions: Illness diagnosed in the first 90 days; pre-existing conditions declared at proposal (simplified).

rider_name: Saffron Life Waiver of Premium Rider
benefit: If the life assured is diagnosed with a listed critical illness or suffers total and permanent disability, all future base premiums are waived and the policy continues.
rider_sa_rule: No sum assured; covers future base premiums.
rider_term_rule: Not available with single pay. Runs for the base premium-paying term, which must end by age 70 (entry age + premium-paying term <= 70).
key_exclusions: As for the critical illness rider.

rider_name: Saffron Life Terminal Illness Benefit (built in)
benefit: If a doctor certifies a terminal illness with life expectancy under 6 months, the death benefit is paid early (up to Rs 2 crore) and the policy ends.
rider_sa_rule: Pays the base death benefit early, capped at Rs 2 crore.
rider_term_rule: Same as the base policy term. Built into the products that list it; no extra premium.
key_exclusions: Not payable in the last 6 months of the policy term.
